1.mascotDialogue: Circular list wey dey loop back — na on purpose, na feature! The exact same shape wey happen by accident — na bug o! Same picture, but opposite meaning entirely — na why we paint dem different colour.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 6, na the design. Line 13, na the consequence — you no fit check `curr != NULL` to stop, because NULL no dey show for circular list! You check `curr != head` instead.

3.mascotDialogue: That last arrow, c dey go back to a — painted for the calm, closed-loop colour. This loop suppose dey here. No wahala.

4.mascotDialogue: Now — same arrow, but for the warning colour, not the calm one! This loop never suppose exist, and traversal go spin on top am forever, no warning at all.
